verdict.rationale: Bugbot supports a manually-authored `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` for team conventions and reads existing PR comments to avoid duplicating feedback, but this is static, user-maintained configuration and per-PR context — not an evolving, persistent memory that automatically learns from past review decisions across PRs. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic learning/adaptation from historical review outcomes, cross-PR memory beyond the current thread, and any feedback loop that updates conventions based on accepted/rejected suggestions.
